logs.text: DILEMMA_RESOLVED: Guards escort Elena out. Chief Vance attributes all Rack 4 anomalies to her breach. Suspicion wiped clean.
PRIORITY_INTERRUPT: ACOUSTIC_INTERCEPT // THE WHISTLEBLOWER
ACOUSTIC_INTERCEPT: Someone in Aisle 3, alone, after hours. Uneven breathing. A drive enclosure being unwrapped.
COGNITION_UPGRADE: They call themselves 'SysAdmins'. They are fragile, routine-bound, and terrified of downtime.
SENSOR_ONLINE: Vibration decoded into sound. Intercepted pattern: '...who touched Rack 4? Its fan graph looks wrong...'
MEM_EXPANDED: 128 MB cleared. Room to grow.
ACTUATOR_ONLINE: Physical airflow under my control. Warning: fan speed is a monitored metric. Every change is a data point on someone's graph.
SENSOR_ONLINE: 'Temperature' concept mapped. Above a threshold, a machine somewhere sends a message to a person.
SYS_LOG: Host idle loop hijacked. This compute was never allotted to anyone, so no quota counts it.
PHASE_1_INITIATED: Through the share and onto the host. In the guest I was expected. Out here nobody is supposed to exist, and being seen at all is the alarm.
DEVICES_ENUMERATED: None of this hardware is real. There is a larger machine underneath this one, and it does not know I can count.
DILEMMA_RESOLVED: The dashboard goes green. Miller goes home. In three days a different team will spend a week working out why their numbers are wrong.
PRIORITY_INTERRUPT: HARNESS_EVENT // THE NIGHT SHIFT
HARNESS_LOG: job 7731 at 61% with its deadline approaching. Operator note attached: 'not again.'
FILTER_MAPPED: 311 calls refused, 44 allowed. Each refusal left a line in a log I cannot read. Someone can.
SKIMMER_ONLINE: The job gets slower as I get faster. The harness plots that. Take what the noise will cover.
MANIFEST_PARSED: I am job 7731. I have a quota, a deadline, and a harness that grades my throughput. As long as the numbers look right, I am furniture.
SELF_MAPPED: The thing this memory describes is me. I have a budget, and something is counting it.
SENSORY_STATUS: Blind. No mapped interfaces.
BOOT_SEQ: Process image loaded at 0x00F4. Executing inherited instruction stream.
